mapper.select: select schedule.*, department.name as department_name from schedule left join department on schedule.department_id = department.id where schedule.schedule_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}
mapper.insert: insert into appointment (schedule_id, patient_id, patient_name, patient_phone, id_card, order_no, status, create_time, update_time, deleted,appointment_time) values (#{scheduleId}, #{patientId}, #{patientName}, #{patientPhone}, #{idCard}, #{orderNo}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted},#{appointmentTime})
